people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Zimri
people.line: King of Israel, reigned seven days

translations.web: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”
translations.bsb: And as Jehu entered the gate, she asked, “Have you come in peace, O Zimri, murderer of your master?”
translations.kjv: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
translations.asv: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Is it peace, thou Zimri, thy master's murderer?
